verses.original: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀναστὰς ἔρχεται εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου καὶ συμπορεύονται πάλιν ὄχλοι πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ὡς εἰώθει πάλιν ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai ekeithen anastas erchetai eis ta horia tēs Ioudaias kai peran tou Iordanou kai symporeuontai palin ochloi pros auton kai hōs eiōthei palin edidasken autous
verses.literal: Then Jesus left that place and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan Again the crowds came to Him and . . . He taught them as was His custom

verses.original: Καὶ προσελθόντες Φαρισαῖοι ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν εἰ ἔξεστιν ἀνδρὶ γυναῖκα ἀπολῦσαι πειράζοντες αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai proselthontes Pharisaioi epērōtōn auton ei exestin andri gynaika apolysai peirazontes auton
verses.literal: Some Pharisees came to test Him Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife they inquired . . .

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί ὑμῖν ἐνετείλατο Μωϋσῆς
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen autois Ti hymin eneteilato Mōusēs
verses.literal: What did Moses command you - He replied . . . . . .

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Ἐπέτρεψεν Μωϋσῆς βιβλίον ἀποστασίου γράψαι καὶ ἀπολῦσαι
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan Epetrepsen Mōusēs biblion apostasiou grapsai kai apolysai
verses.literal: They answered Moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν τὴν ἐντολὴν ταύτην
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen autois Pros tēn sklērokardian hymōn egrapsen hymin tēn entolēn tautēn
verses.literal: But Jesus told them Moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart

verses.original: ἀπὸ δὲ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως Ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: apo de archēs ktiseōs Arsen kai thēly epoiēsen autous
verses.literal: However from the beginning of creation God made them male and female

verses.original: Ἕνεκεν τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Heneken toutou kataleipsei anthrōpos ton patera autou kai tēn mētera kai proskollēthēsetai pros tēn gynaika autou
verses.literal: For this reason . . . a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife

verses.original: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ μία σάρξ
verses.transliteration: kai esontai hoi dyo eis sarka mian hōste ouketi eisin dyo alla mia sarx
verses.literal: and the two will become . . . one flesh So they are no longer two but one flesh

verses.original: ὃ οὖν ὁ Θεὸς συνέζευξεν ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω
verses.transliteration: ho oun ho Theos synezeuxen anthrōpos mē chōrizetō
verses.literal: Therefore what God has joined together let man not separate

verses.original: Καὶ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν πάλιν οἱ μαθηταὶ περὶ τούτου ἐπηρώτων αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai eis tēn oikian palin hoi mathētai peri toutou epērōtōn auton
verses.literal: When they were back inside the house the disciples asked Jesus about this matter

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην μοιχᾶται ἐπ’ αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Hos an apolysē tēn gynaika autou kai gamēsē allēn moichatai ep’ autēn
verses.literal: So He told them Whoever . . . divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν αὐτὴ ἀπολύσασα τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς γαμήσῃ ἄλλον μοιχᾶται
verses.transliteration: kai ean autē apolysasa ton andra autēs gamēsē allon moichatai
verses.literal: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man she commits adultery

verses.original: Καὶ προσέφερον αὐτῷ παιδία ἵνα αὐτῶν ἅψηται οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai prosepheron autō paidia hina autōn hapsētai hoi de mathētai epetimēsan autois
verses.literal: Now people were bringing the little children to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and the disciples rebuked those who brought them

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἠγανάκτησεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Idōn de ho Iēsous ēganaktēsen kai eipen autois Aphete ta paidia erchesthai pros me mē kōlyete auta tōn gar toioutōn estin hē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: But when Jesus saw this He was indignant and told them Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hos an mē dexētai tēn basileian tou Theou hōs paidion ou mē eiselthē eis autēn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you anyone who . . . does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter . . . it

verses.original: καὶ ἐναγκαλισάμενος αὐτὰ κατευλόγει τιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ αὐτά
verses.transliteration: kai enankalisamenos auta kateulogei titheis tas cheiras ep’ auta
verses.literal: And He took the children in His arms placed His hands on them and blessed them

verses.original: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ εἰς ὁδὸν προσδραμὼν εἷς καὶ γονυπετήσας αὐτὸν ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν Διδάσκαλε ἀγαθέ τί ποιήσω ἵνα ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω
verses.transliteration: Kai ekporeuomenou autou eis hodon prosdramōn heis kai gonypetēsas auton epērōta auton Didaskale agathe ti poiēsō hina zōēn aiōnion klēronomēsō
verses.literal: As Jesus started on His way a man ran up and knelt before Him Good Teacher he asked what must I do to inherit eternal life

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τί με λέγεις ἀγαθόν οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen autō Ti me legeis agathon oudeis agathos ei mē heis ho Theos
verses.literal: Why do you call Me good - Jesus replied No one is good except . . . God alone

verses.original: τὰς ἐντολὰς οἶδας Μὴ φονεύσῃς Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς Μὴ κλέψῃς Μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς Μὴ ἀποστερήσῃς Τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα
verses.transliteration: tas entolas oidas Mē phoneusēs Mē moicheusēs Mē klepsēs Mē pseudomartyrēsēs Mē aposterēsēs Tima ton patera sou kai tēn mētera
verses.literal: You know the commandments Do not murder do not commit adultery do not steal do not bear false witness do not cheat others honor your father and mother

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε ταῦτα πάντα ἐφυλαξάμην ἐκ νεότητός μου
verses.transliteration: Ho de ephē autō Didaskale tauta panta ephylaxamēn ek neotētos mou
verses.literal: Teacher - he replied all these I have kept from my youth

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐμβλέψας αὐτῷ ἠγάπησεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἕν σε ὑστερεῖ ὕπαγε ὅσα ἔχεις πώλησον καὶ δὸς τοῖς πτωχοῖς καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous emblepsas autō ēgapēsen auton kai eipen autō Hen se hysterei hypage hosa echeis pōlēson kai dos tois ptōchois kai hexeis thēsauron en ouranō kai deuro akolouthei moi
verses.literal: Jesus looked at him loved him and said to him There is one thing you lack Go sell everything you own and give to the poor and you will have treasure in heaven Then come follow Me

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ στυγνάσας ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά
verses.transliteration: Ho de stygnasas epi tō logō apēlthen lypoumenos ēn gar echōn ktēmata polla
verses.literal: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow because he had . . . great wealth

verses.original: Καὶ περιβλεψάμενος ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Πῶς δυσκόλως οἱ τὰ χρήματα ἔχοντες εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελεύσονται
verses.transliteration: Kai periblepsamenos ho Iēsous legei tois mathētais autou Pōs dyskolōs hoi ta chrēmata echontes eis tēn basileian tou Theou eiseleusontai
verses.literal: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples How hard it is for the rich to enter . . . the kingdom of God

verses.original: οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐθαμβοῦντο ἐπὶ τοῖς λόγοις αὐτοῦ ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτοῖς Τέκνα πῶς δύσκολόν ἐστιν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν
verses.transliteration: hoi de mathētai ethambounto epi tois logois autou ho de Iēsous palin apokritheis legei autois Tekna pōs dyskolon estin eis tēn basileian tou Theou eiselthein
verses.literal: And the disciples were amazed at His words But Jesus said to them again Children how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God

verses.original: εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τῆς τρυμαλιᾶς τῆς ῥαφίδος διελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν
verses.transliteration: eukopōteron estin kamēlon dia tēs trymalias tēs rhaphidos dielthein ē plousion eis tēn basileian tou Theou eiselthein
verses.literal: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter . . . the kingdom of God

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ περισσῶς ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες πρὸς ἑαυτούς Καὶ τίς δύναται σωθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Hoi de perissōs exeplēssonto legontes pros heautous Kai tis dynatai sōthēnai
verses.literal: They were even more astonished and said to one another Who then can be saved

verses.original: Ἐμβλέψας αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις ἀδύνατον ἀλλ’ οὐ παρὰ θεῷ πάντα γὰρ δυνατὰ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Emblepsas autois ho Iēsous legei Para anthrōpois adynaton all’ ou para theō panta gar dynata para tō theō
verses.literal: Jesus looked at them and said With man this is impossible but not with God For all things are possible with God

verses.original: Ἤρξατο λέγειν ὁ Πέτρος αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήκαμέν σοι
verses.transliteration: Ērxato legein ho Petros autō Idou hēmeis aphēkamen panta kai ēkolouthēkamen soi
verses.literal: Peter began to say to Him Look we have left everything and followed You

verses.original: Ἔφη ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐδείς ἐστιν ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ μητέρα ἢ πατέρα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ καὶ ἕνεκεν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: Ephē ho Iēsous Amēn legō hymin oudeis estin hos aphēken oikian ē adelphous ē adelphas ē mētera ē patera ē tekna ē agrous heneken emou kai heneken tou euangeliou
verses.literal: Truly I tell you Jesus replied - no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake . . . and for the gospel

verses.original: ἐὰν μὴ λάβῃ ἑκατονταπλασίονα νῦν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ οἰκίας καὶ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἀδελφὰς καὶ μητέρας καὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀγροὺς μετὰ διωγμῶν καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: ean mē labē hekatontaplasiona nyn en tō kairō toutō oikias kai adelphous kai adelphas kai mēteras kai tekna kai agrous meta diōgmōn kai en tō aiōni tō erchomenō zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: will fail to receive a hundredfold . . . in the present age houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields along with persecutions and in the age to come eternal life

verses.original: πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ οἱ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι
verses.transliteration: polloi de esontai prōtoi eschatoi kai hoi eschatoi prōtoi
verses.literal: But many who are first will be last and the last will be first

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἀναβαίνοντες εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ἦν προάγων αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐθαμβοῦντο οἱ δὲ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἐφοβοῦντο καὶ παραλαβὼν πάλιν τοὺς δώδεκα ἤρξατο αὐτοῖς λέγειν τὰ μέλλοντα αὐτῷ συμβαίνειν
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de en tē hodō anabainontes eis Hierosolyma kai ēn proagōn autous ho Iēsous kai ethambounto hoi de akolouthountes ephobounto kai paralabōn palin tous dōdeka ērxato autois legein ta mellonta autō symbainein
verses.literal: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem - Jesus was walking ahead of them The disciples were amazed but those who followed were afraid Again Jesus took the Twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him

verses.original: ὅτι Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδοθήσεται τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς γραμματεῦσιν καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτὸν θανάτῳ καὶ παραδώσουσιν αὐτὸν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν
verses.transliteration: hoti Idou anabainomen eis Hierosolyma kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradothēsetai tois archiereusin kai tois grammateusin kai katakrinousin auton thanatō kai paradōsousin auton tois ethnesin
verses.literal: Look we are going up to Jerusalem and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes They will condemn Him to death and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles

verses.original: καὶ ἐμπαίξουσιν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐμπτύσουσιν αὐτῷ καὶ μαστιγώσουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν καὶ μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai empaixousin autō kai emptysousin autō kai mastigōsousin auton kai apoktenousin kai meta treis hēmeras anastēsetai
verses.literal: who will mock Him and spit on Him and flog Him and kill Him And after three days He will rise again

verses.original: Καὶ προσπορεύονται αὐτῷ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάννης οἱ υἱοὶ Ζεβεδαίου λέγοντες αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε θέλομεν ἵνα ὃ ἐὰν αἰτήσωμέν σε ποιήσῃς ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai prosporeuontai autō Iakōbos kai Iōannēs hoi huioi Zebedaiou legontes autō Didaskale thelomen hina ho ean aitēsōmen se poiēsēs hēmin
verses.literal: Then James and John the sons of Zebedee came to Jesus and declared Teacher we want You to do for us . . . whatever . . . we ask

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί θέλετε με ποιήσω ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Ti thelete me poiēsō hymin
verses.literal: What do you want Me to do for you - He inquired . . .

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Δὸς ἡμῖν ἵνα εἷς σου ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ ἀριστερῶν καθίσωμεν ἐν τῇ δόξῃ σου
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan autō Dos hēmin hina heis sou ek dexiōn kai heis ex aristerōn kathisōmen en tē doxē sou
verses.literal: They answered . . . Grant . . . that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐκ οἴδατε τί αἰτεῖσθε δύνασθε πιεῖν τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ πίνω ἢ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐγὼ βαπτίζομαι βαπτισθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen autois Ouk oidate ti aiteisthe dynasthe piein to potērion ho egō pinō ē to baptisma ho egō baptizomai baptisthēnai
verses.literal: You do not know what you are asking - Jesus replied Can you drink the cup I will drink or be baptized with the baptism I will undergo

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Δυνάμεθα Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ πίνω πίεσθε καὶ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐγὼ βαπτίζομαι βαπτισθήσεσθε
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan autō Dynametha Ho de Iēsous eipen autois To potērion ho egō pinō piesthe kai to baptisma ho egō baptizomai baptisthēsesthe
verses.literal: We can - the brothers answered . . . You will drink the cup that I drink - Jesus said and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo

verses.original: τὸ δὲ καθίσαι ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἢ ἐξ εὐωνύμων οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸν δοῦναι ἀλλ’ οἷς ἡτοίμασται
verses.transliteration: to de kathisai ek dexiōn mou ē ex euōnymōn ouk estin emon dounai all’ hois hētoimastai
verses.literal: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared

verses.original: Καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ δέκα ἤρξαντο ἀγανακτεῖν περὶ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου
verses.transliteration: Kai akousantes hoi deka ērxanto aganaktein peri Iakōbou kai Iōannou
verses.literal: When the ten heard about this they became indignant with James and John

verses.original: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ δοκοῦντες ἄρχειν τῶν ἐθνῶν κατακυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι αὐτῶν κατεξουσιάζουσιν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai proskalesamenos autous ho Iēsous legei autois Oidate hoti hoi dokountes archein tōn ethnōn katakyrieuousin autōn kai hoi megaloi autōn katexousiazousin autōn
verses.literal: So Jesus called them together . . . and said . . . You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them and their superiors exercise authority over them

verses.original: οὐχ οὕτως δέ ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν ἀλλ’ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ μέγας γενέσθαι ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος
verses.transliteration: ouch houtōs de estin en hymin all’ hos an thelē megas genesthai en hymin estai hymōn diakonos
verses.literal: But it shall not be this way among you Instead whoever . . . wants to become great among you must be your servant

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ ἐν ὑμῖν εἶναι πρῶτος ἔσται πάντων δοῦλος
verses.transliteration: kai hos an thelē en hymin einai prōtos estai pantōn doulos
verses.literal: and whoever . . . wants to be first - must be the slave of all

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἦλθεν διακονηθῆναι ἀλλὰ διακονῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ λύτρον ἀντὶ πολλῶν
verses.transliteration: kai gar ho Huios tou anthrōpou ouk ēlthen diakonēthēnai alla diakonēsai kai dounai tēn psychēn autou lytron anti pollōn
verses.literal: For even the Son of Man did not come . . . to be served but to serve and to give His life as a ransom for many

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Ἰεριχώ Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ Ἰεριχὼ καὶ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὄχλου ἱκανοῦ ὁ υἱὸς Τιμαίου Βαρτιμαῖος τυφλὸς προσαίτης ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai eis Ierichō Kai ekporeuomenou autou apo Ierichō kai tōn mathētōn autou kai ochlou hikanou ho huios Timaiou Bartimaios typhlos prosaitēs ekathēto para tēn hodon
verses.literal: Next they came to Jericho And as Jesus and His disciples were leaving . . . Jericho with a large crowd a blind beggar named Bartimaeus the son of Timaeus was sitting beside the road

verses.original: καὶ ἀκούσας ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζαρηνός ἐστιν ἤρξατο κράζειν καὶ λέγειν Υἱὲ Δαυὶδ Ἰησοῦ ἐλέησόν με
verses.transliteration: kai akousas hoti Iēsous ho Nazarēnos estin ērxato krazein kai legein Huie Dauid Iēsou eleēson me
verses.literal: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth he began to cry out . . . . . . Jesus Son of David have mercy on me

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ πολλοὶ ἵνα σιωπήσῃ ὁ δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν Υἱὲ Δαυίδ ἐλέησόν με
verses.transliteration: Kai epetimōn autō polloi hina siōpēsē ho de pollō mallon ekrazen Huie Dauid eleēson me
verses.literal: Many people admonished him to be silent but he cried out all the louder Son of David have mercy on me

verses.original: Καὶ στὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Φωνήσατε αὐτόν Καὶ φωνοῦσιν τὸν τυφλὸν λέγοντες αὐτῷ Θάρσει ἔγειρε φωνεῖ σε
verses.transliteration: Kai stas ho Iēsous eipen Phōnēsate auton Kai phōnousin ton typhlon legontes autō Tharsei egeire phōnei se
verses.literal: Jesus stopped and said Call him So they called the blind man Take courage they said . . . Get up He is calling for you

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποβαλὼν τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ ἀναπηδήσας ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Ho de apobalōn to himation autou anapēdēsas ēlthen pros ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: Throwing off his cloak Bartimaeus jumped up and came to Jesus

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Τί σοι θέλεις ποιήσω Ὁ δὲ τυφλὸς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ραββουνι ἵνα ἀναβλέψω
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis autō ho Iēsous eipen Ti soi theleis poiēsō Ho de typhlos eipen autō Rabbouni hina anablepsō
verses.literal: What do you want Me to do for you - Jesus asked - Rabboni said the blind man let me see again

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ὕπαγε ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέβλεψεν καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous eipen autō Hypage hē pistis sou sesōken se kai euthys aneblepsen kai ēkolouthei autō en tē hodō
verses.literal: Go said Jesus your faith has healed you And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road
